cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

mechanism: A manages B comfort after a cold journey, switching from blankets to the requested foot warmth while every comfort recalls B old neglect.
confusable: Unlike revenge by withholding help, A actually remains caring; borrowed authority changes the method to keep B close while resentment sharpens the help.
comparison: Shared bed and feet differ from a delayed birthday celebration with cake.
seedUse: Use D93-b taxi/blanket/office wait/feet and S02-b adapting the offered method to B direct request.
